title: Repair Guarantee and Replace-or-Repair Threshold for Optional Coverage Add-Ons Work
content:
**Claims guidance.** For a repair or replacement under an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider, the authorized work cost follows the request's history and figures, judged in this order:

1. **Repair guarantee.** When a repair of the same component was authorized on the rider no more than the rider's repair guarantee period before the authorization date, the contractor's repair guarantee carries the work, and the authorized work cost is zero. The repair guarantee period is 30 calendar days for every rider.
2. **Replacement.** Otherwise, the component is replaced, and the authorized work cost is the contracted replacement cost, in either of two cases:
   - the repair estimate is at or above the rider's repair-to-replace threshold rate times the contracted replacement cost; the threshold rate is 0.60 (60 percent) for every rider; or
   - the covered determination records no repair estimate above zero because the contractor found that the component cannot be repaired, or that its parts cannot be obtained within the rider's parts lead time; the parts lead time is 14 calendar days for every rider.
3. **Repair.** Otherwise the component is repaired, and the authorized work cost is the repair estimate.

| Repair of the same component authorized on the rider within the past 30 calendar days | Repair estimate on the covered determination | Work | Authorized work cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Any | Carried by the repair guarantee | Zero |
| No | At or above 0.60 of the contracted replacement cost | Replacement | The contracted replacement cost |
| No | None above zero recorded, the component being unrepairable or its parts not obtainable within 14 calendar days | Replacement | The contracted replacement cost |
| No | Above zero and below 0.60 of the contracted replacement cost | Repair | The repair estimate |

The repair estimate and the contracted replacement cost are those on the request's covered coverage determination.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical figures)

- An earlier repair of the same pool pump was authorized 30 calendar days before today's authorization date: the guarantee carries the work and the cost is zero. Had it been 31 days before, the guarantee would not apply.
- A contracted replacement cost of USD 1,000.00 and a repair estimate of USD 600.00: the estimate is at 0.60 of the replacement cost, so the component is replaced and the cost is USD 1,000.00.
- The same replacement cost with a repair estimate of USD 599.99: below 0.60, so the component is repaired at USD 599.99.
- The same replacement cost, with the determination recording no repair estimate because the well pump's parts cannot be obtained within 14 calendar days: the component is replaced at USD 1,000.00.
